how.title: How it works
how.step1.title: Create your rider
how.step1.text: You start in the Rookie league with a single rider who is entirely yours.
how.step2.title: Choose races and training
how.step2.text: Every stage has its own profile. Prepare for the one that suits you.
how.step3.title: Climb the leagues
how.step3.text: Results decide promotion. Each league brings new stages with it.

facilities.rookieLocked: Facility upgrades unlock in the Amateur league.
facilities.storedLevelNote: Stored level {stored} — active as L{effective} in your current league.
facilities.infoPanelText: The Rookie league is an introduction to the game — all 5 buildings are visible at level 1, upgrades are locked for now. Persistent building starts in the Amateur league. Promotion raises the maximum available level; if you later drop to a lower league, your progress is not reset — bonuses temporarily apply only up to the current league’s cap.
facilities.trainingDesc: Supports rider development during weekly training.
facilities.recoveryDesc: Helps riders recover energy faster and reduce fatigue.
facilities.scoutingDesc: Improves the quality of information on scouted riders.
facilities.technicalDesc: Reduces technical problems and service-related costs.
facilities.teamCenterDesc: Sets rider and staff capacity for the team.
facilities.trainingUnlock.l1: Unlocks better development conditions for riders aged 17–23.
facilities.trainingUnlock.l4: Unlocks elite conditions for experienced riders and prepares performance-retention support.
facilities.recoveryIdentitySub.l2: Riders recover more effectively between training and races.
facilities.recoveryIdentitySub.l3: Better conditions for regaining energy and managing fatigue.
facilities.recoveryIdentitySub.l4: A high level of care for a demanding schedule.
facilities.recoveryIdentitySub.l5: Top-tier conditions for sustaining a heavy training and race load long-term.
facilities.recoveryUnlock.l1: Improves the team's ability to restore energy and reduce fatigue between training and races.
facilities.recoveryUnlock.l3: Raises recovery quality for a more demanding training and race schedule.
facilities.recoveryUnlock.l4: Unlocks elite-level care for riders' recovery.

bikeCard.title: My bike
ranking.divisionNoRank: Division standings are not available yet. Points will be awarded after the first races.
ranking.divisionNone: You are not placed in a division yet.
ranking.divisionEqual: Divisions within a league are equal in strength.
ranking.divisionMembersEmpty: The list of riders in this division is empty for now.
radar.devNote: Development is only an estimate. The true hidden values stay undisclosed and do not count towards the overall score.
radar.devNoteUnknown: Development has not been scouted yet. The true hidden values are not revealed and do not count towards the overall score.
groupDesc.performance: The rider's physical performance across different types of terrain.
groupDesc.tactics: How well the rider reads the race and makes decisions.
groupDesc.technique: Bike handling and coping with technical conditions.
groupDesc.experience: Racing experience gained over the career.
attrDesc.endurance: Ability to sustain effort over long stages.
attrDesc.acceleration: Ability to accelerate quickly in attacks and sprints.
attrDesc.energyManagement: Ability to spread effort across a race.
attrDesc.positioning: Ability to hold a good position in the peloton.
attrDesc.reaction: Quick response to changes in the race.
attrDesc.breakawaySkill: Ability to stay away in a breakaway.
attrDesc.packRiding: Confident riding in a crowded peloton.
attrDesc.attackTiming: Ability to choose the right moment to attack.
attrDesc.roughSurface: Coping with rough surfaces such as cobbles.
styleDesc.climber: A rider suited to long, demanding climbs in mountain terrain.
styleDesc.allrounder: A versatile rider with no clear weakness, usable on many kinds of course.
styleDesc.rouleur: A rider suited to flat courses and long solo efforts.
styleDesc.puncheur: A rider suited to rolling courses, short climbs and attacking racing.
styleDesc.sprinter: A rider suited to flat stages ending in a bunch sprint.
styleDesc.timeTrial: A rider suited to time trials and steady pace on the flat.
styleDesc.classics: A rider suited to classics with rough surfaces and technical sections.

bikePage.title: My bike
bikePage.subtitle: Manage your bike's equipment, service it and upgrade components.
bikePage.desc.frame: The frame is the base of the bike. A higher level can bring better construction, lower weight or better aerodynamics.
bikePage.desc.wheels: Wheels affect weight, aerodynamics and rim quality.
bikePage.desc.tires: Tyres affect rolling resistance, grip and wear.
bikePage.desc.brakes: Brakes affect braking power, downhill control and wear.
bikePage.desc.drivetrain: The drivetrain affects power transfer efficiency, drivetrain quality and wear.
bikePage.lockNote: Your league allows levels up to {max}. Higher ones unlock in {league} and above.
bikePage.maxReached: This component is at the highest level.
bikePage.valuesPending: Property values are not decided yet.
bikePage.purchaseNote: Purchasing will be available once the economy and secure server transactions are approved.
bikePage.noWear: Wear is not tracked for this component yet.
bikePage.frameNoWear: The frame has no classic wear like tyres or drivetrain yet.
bikePage.serviceNote: Service will restore the component's condition without losing its level. Price and activation will follow after approval.
bikeCard.missing: This value is not tracked yet

trainingPlans.title: Training plans
trainingPlans.intro: Pick one of seven plans. A plan develops several attributes at once: main and supplementary.
trainingPlans.deadline: You can change the plan until Monday 18:00 UTC.
trainingPlans.preselected: Preselected from your previous setting. Nothing changes until you save the plan.
trainingPlans.noPlan: Without a plan there is no training, but regeneration continues.
trainingPlans.locked: This week has been processed; the plan can no longer be changed.
trainingPlans.blockedRaceWeek: Next week is a race week, so no training is planned.
trainingPlans.blockedTour: You are registered for a Tour that week, so no training is planned.
trainingPlans.errTour: The plan cannot be saved: you are registered for a Tour that week.
trainingPlans.errDisabled: The new training plans are not enabled yet.
trainingPlans.activeRaceWeek: This is a race week: there is no regular training.
trainingPlans.activeNoPlan: You have no plan for this week. The deadline was Monday 18:00 UTC of the previous week and training cannot be done retroactively. Regeneration continues.
trainingPlans.activeLegacy: This week has a training confirmed with your previous setting; it runs under the old rules.
trainingPlans.activeLocked: The plan has been locked since Monday 18:00 UTC.
trainingPlans.blockedCalendar: The calendar does not match the database; planning is paused for now.
calendar.mismatch: Dates cannot be verified right now: the web calendar does not match the database. The admin is on it.
trainingPlans.activeEditable: You can still change the plan until Monday 18:00 UTC (form below).
trainingPlans.activeNoPlanOpen: You have no plan for this week yet. You can choose one below until Monday 18:00 UTC.
sp.subtitle: Contracts and offers from your team’s sponsors.
sp.section.none: There are no offers here yet.
sp.finance.note: Financial terms are being prepared. Signing sponsor contracts is not available yet.
sp.demo.banner: Sample data for checking the design. These are not real contracts or offers and nothing is paid out.
sp.empty.contracts: You have no active sponsor contract yet.
sp.empty.market: There are no offers on the sponsor market yet.
sp.soon: Available once the finances are approved
sp.detail.optional: The goals are optional. Missing them means no penalty and no loss of the guaranteed income.
sp.detail.repeatable: Repeatable: the bonus is paid every time it is achieved.
sp.detail.once: One-time: the bonus is paid only once.
sp.detail.notEvaluated: Evaluation of this goal waits for the game systems to be completed.
sp.detail.cross: The contract runs across season borders. Promotion or relegation neither changes nor ends it.
sp.detail.severance: Early termination fee: 30 % of the remaining guaranteed income.
sp.block.money: Signing opens once the finances are approved.
sp.block.slots_full: The slot is taken. You can see the offer but cannot sign it.
sp.block.same_sponsor: This sponsor cannot be signed twice in a row.
sp.block.other: This offer cannot be signed right now.
sp.goal.anyJersey: Win any official jersey at a Tour
sp.goal.promotion: Get promoted to a higher league
sp.goal.participateWorlds: Take part in the World Championships
sp.goal.top3Worlds: Finish in the top 3 at the World Championships
sp.market.note: The game picked these offers for you automatically. Goals are set automatically and cannot be changed. A rejected or expired offer is replaced at the next Sunday update.
